caveats: No keyword volumes: the search tool exposed no People-Also-Ask or volume data. Demand evidence is qualitative (number of competing pages, forums, courses). Validate with Search Console impressions before scaling any page type.
Domain tag "video production" (185) and "art" are noisy enrichment defaults; only 38 of the 185 mention a video-generation tool. Pillar counts use stricter rules.

Affiliate list and corpus are mismatched: top-ranked ElevenLabs has 3 entries; Webflow, Raycast, Hostinger, RunPod have 0. Building pages to fit affiliates would be thin affiliation under Google spam policy.
The biggest pillar (agentic coding) has no affiliate program in affiliates.json; its monetization is the done-for-you service and the skill, not /go/.
Gemini CLI free-tier change (reported 2026-06-18) and World Labs/AMD deal come from single or vendor sources; verify before publishing.
Google scaled-content policy has no published thresholds; the >=5 entries / 150 words / batch-of-20 rules are practitioner heuristics.
llms.txt: 2026 studies show near-zero AI reads; our own crawler logs are better evidence. Update guides/llms-txt-standard so it is not cited as wrong.
Quant/prediction-market pages are YMYL-adjacent and the corpus tiers are weak (Polymarket entries are all B/C); keep builder framing, no profit claims.
l1b3rt4s-jailbreak-repo guide is a reputational risk for a site seeking affiliate approvals; consider noindex.
Head terms (best ai video generator, claude code vs cursor, kalshi vs polymarket, ai trading bot, what is mcp, image to 3d model free) are saturated: skip.
